records.title: Conversion of two lane road to four lane in Bhilwara
details: Part (C); Preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) for four laning of this stretch has been taken up.

records.title: Benefits to AWWs in Rajasthan
details: (a) to (f): It has been announced in the interim budget FY 2024-25 to extend healthcare annual coverage of Rs.5 Lakhs under Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) to all Anganwadi workers and helpers.
